scripts.api: set -a; [ ! -f api/.env.local ] || . api/.env.local; set +a; AOCN_DEV=true SITE_URL="${SITE_URL:-http://localhost:4321}" DOORS_DIR=../../aocn-challenges/build DATABASE_URL="postgres://postgres@/postgres?host=$PGHOST&port=$PGPORT" go run -C api ./cmd/api-server
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix web && go build -C api -o /dev/null ./cmd/api-server && go build -C cli -o /dev/null ./cmd/aocn
scripts.test: TEST_DATABASE_URL="postgres://postgres@/postgres?host=$PGHOST&port=$PGPORT" go -C api test ./... && go -C cli test ./... && npm test --prefix web
